# open-sites.io

> Web studio based in Batumi, Georgia. We design and build landing pages, multi-page business websites,
> online stores, websites with an AI assistant and Telegram Mini Apps for small businesses.
> Fixed price agreed before work starts, 50% prepayment. Site languages: Russian, English, Georgian.

## Services and prices

- Store “Your Own Storefront”: For businesses with dozens of products or services, where customers prefer to choose on their own first and then order. Price: 990 GEL / 369 USD / 29900 RUB.
- Landing page “First Leads”: For launching a service, an offer or a new line of business when you need leads by next week. Price: 290 GEL / 109 USD / 8900 RUB.
- Website “Bridge to Clients”: For businesses with several services, where customers want to look everything over calmly before booking. Price: 590 GEL / 219 USD / 17900 RUB.
- Site + AI “Always On”: For businesses that lose leads in the evenings and on weekends because nobody is there to reply. Price: 790 GEL / 295 USD / 23900 RUB.
- App “In the Client's Pocket”: For businesses with regular customers who like to book, order and collect loyalty points right on their phone. Price is quoted after a short call.
- Support “In Good Hands”: For those who don't want to look after the site themselves or keep a developer on the payroll. Price: 60 GEL / 22 USD / 1800 RUB per month.

The client buys the domain in their own name; we help choose, buy and connect it. Hosting of a static site is free.
